senses.gloss:
तिप्प भट्ट son of Citti Bhaṭṭa:
 Lakṣaṇarājī ny. Burnell 120^b. Oppert II, 9648.

तिप्पाभट्ट surnamed Gahvara, son of Rāma Bhaṭṭa,
grandson of Bālambhaṭṭa:
 Smārtaprāyaścitta.

तिप्पू or तिप्पा भट्ट surnamed Gahvara, son of Rāma
Bhaṭṭa, grandson of Bālambhaṭṭa:
 Agniṣṭomasya Saptahautraprayogaḥ or Hautrika-
prayogaḥ.
 Saṃskāranirṇaya.
 Saṃgrahadīpikā, a precise C. on Āśvalāyana's
Śrautasūtra. Written at Benares in 1776.
CS 2, 228 (only the second Adhyāya).

तिप्पू भट्ट son of Rāma Bhaṭṭa (Yāhvaropanāmaka):
 Saṃgrahaṇadīpikā, a C. on Āśvalāyana's Śrauta-
sūtra.

तापीखण्ड or तीपीमाहात्म्य from the Skandapurāṇa. CS
4, 294. IO. 3154.
